associations.rationale: Under the algebraic-closure, finite-dimensionality, and simplicity hypotheses, the formal type directly equates an A-linear equivalence of ExtMod extensions with f-cf' being a coboundary for some nonzero scalar c.
The proportionality conclusion is present, but the isomorphism side is expressed through an existential witness of the opaque IntertwinesExt predicate rather than a direct module equivalence.
